name: Hello Poppy
description: A minimal AgentsPoppy extension — the clone-and-go starting point.

permissionSet.name: Hello Poppy backend
permissionSet.description: Reads its own caller identity. Replace these grants with the AWS access YOUR extension needs (least-privilege, scoped to its own resources).

grants.reason: Reads which AWS account and identity it is running as, so it can show you the account it is connected to. AWS publishes no resource type for this call, so it cannot be narrowed.
